origin: user report 2026-09-08: white specks on a shadowed wall beside a window while flying the Sponza scene
resolution:
Completed on 2026-10-09, after the 2026-10-08 closure review, the engine changes it listed (8fb13fa1) and the runs of 2026-10-09 (notes.md, "Close-out runs (2026-10-09)"). All 16 items were ticked by 2026-09-23, and the code landed in 7eea6b95.

Estimator fixes: GatherSdfReflections applies the Karis 1/(1+luma) weight and keeps the below-horizon weight in the denominator (sdf_reflections.hlsli:268, 283-285). The radiance cache selects probes by the geometric normal (deferred_lighting_ps.hlsl:932). Both are guarded by scripts/rendering/test_sdf_reflection_firefly.ps1 (18 checks).

4.4: readiness is no longer gated on the recentre flag (radiance_cache.h:227-229).

4.5: lighting indexes the completed SH buffer with GetCompletedGridOrigin() (frame_constants.cpp:811), and a recentre scrolls the probe history (radiance_cache.cpp:776-778, radiance_cache_trace_cs.hlsl:596-633). The guard, scripts/rendering/test_rc_recentre_scroll.ps1, went stale with blocks B-02 (0a9cc732, 464-byte trace constants) and B-06 (edfd7942, DDGI mirror in ddgi_probe_common.hlsli). It was re-anchored on 2026-10-08 and has 42 checks; 42/42 in PowerShell on 2026-10-09.

4.1: closed on 2026-09-23 without a filter, by the pre-registered decision of ledger H-68. Measured in linear radiance on that day's build, the isolated pixels left in the TAA output at pose A's rear_door and right_shadow are not reflection pixels; shadow_wall keeps none (H-41). H-68b corrects H-68's repeatability statement and adds the energy reading: about 90 % of the door's isolated-pixel luminance goes with the translucent pass (followup-12's door mechanism). The low-energy remainder (~170/frame with translucency off) is accepted. 4.1's original no-TAA success test was not met. The sparkle without TAA is accepted and documented: r.TAA defaults to false, and sample/projects/sponza.uzproject sets r.TAA 1. The exposure-relative or clamped Karis weight handed over by followup-08 4.1 was declined. The weight keeps 88 % of the energy in the layered fixture and agrees within 1 % under a uniform environment, and r.GI.Reflections.HdrWeight=0 gives the plain mean.

4.2: the shadows, lighting, lightingonly and ao debug views were fixed on 2026-09-16. scripts/rendering/run_debug_view_check.py read 7/7 on the 09-16, 09-21 and 10-05 binaries and on the Debug builds of 2026-10-09 (2cc2e85c and 8fb13fa1, 240 frames: at 40 frames the requested frame 39 fell inside the 44-frame pre-load, which takes no screenshots). The GTAO-off ao fallback matched the shadows view's lit level on 2026-10-09 (171 and 171).

4.3: single-channel and unreadable --diag targets were fixed on 2026-09-16. The RGBA targets 4.3 named (gbuffer.emissive, hdr, lighting.direct/indirect/shadow) got RGB/R channel selectors in 8fb13fa1 (verify_sponza_loading.ps1 on 2026-10-09: emissive RGB 0/0 WARN_ZERO, hdr and lighting RGB, shadow R). The reflections debug view shows "no data" magenta while SSR is inactive (8fb13fa1; 98.9 % magenta at SSR off). The volfog and hiz.mip0 zeros are explained by 8851f37e (no volumetric fog in sponza.uzscene) and 9f1be63f (Hi-Z built after the GBuffer).
